findings.title: Launch-time contract identity is not closed over exact RTL and admission-to-contract equality
findings.evidence: runner lines 92-117 verify a subset against future admission but never iterate contract.exact_files and never cross-compare all admission identities with the frozen contract
findings.impact: RTL or tool/library inputs can drift after review while the runner still launches
findings.required_fix: verify every contract.exact_files entry and every admission identity against its contract field before preflight, attempt consumption, or DC

findings.title: runtime_final snapshot is recorded but not gated
findings.evidence: runner lines 361-413 evaluate only loop samples; lines 415-418 take a final snapshot without counter update or immediate-gate evaluation
findings.impact: the third consecutive low-commit sample or a final Mem/Swap/cgroup/OOM/external-EDA violation can be logged yet still pass
findings.required_fix: apply one shared snapshot evaluation routine to loop and final samples and quarantine on a final violation

findings.title: Campaign process identity is vulnerable to PID reuse
findings.evidence: runner lines 125-137, 361, and 409 use numeric PID/PPID ancestry and kill -0/TERM without a frozen /proc starttime identity
findings.impact: a reused PID can cause a non-campaign EDA collision to be excluded or an unrelated process to be signaled
findings.required_fix: freeze and verify root PID plus starttime UID and executable identity before liveness, descendant exclusion, or signaling

findings.title: Descendant provenance records comm rather than the contracted full command
findings.evidence: runner lines 359-377 source Name from /proc status into a comm-only TSV, while contract runtime.recorded_every_sample requires command
findings.impact: sealed evidence cannot independently reconstruct invocation arguments or distinguish same-name processes
findings.required_fix: record a normalized/redacted cmdline or args plus executable identity in per-sample and high-water evidence

authorization.required_next_step: new-identity bounded author repair followed by a fresh independent static hammer
